matrix.retry_policy: client: 7 attempts x 2/4/8/16/32/64s backoff (G3 hardening); cell-level retry 3x with 2/4/8 min backoff (cvs_matrix)

split.gate_role: null-detector: channel not dormant; immune to post-hoc tuning
split.hypothesis_role: effect-size claims, tested on the REAL matrix at G5; never tuned after seeing results

claims.assertion: life_state channel ablated (goldfish): life-arc IDENTITY does not survive midnight — every seed shows non-empty per-day arc id sets with consecutive days DISJOINT (fresh arcs, fresh progress each day), while FULL persists arc ids across days

GATE (canal no dormido): n_proactive, eventos disparados o horas proactivas divergen de FULL por >= 5% (o artefactos realizados no idénticos) — el margen de efecto preregistrado 0.15 se prueba en la matriz real

generation_controls channel ablated (B4 preregistered, merge f48683d): the cell's realized actuator controls are the pinned flat set (max_tokens 600, response_delay_s 5.0 s, closing_tendency 0.5, single closing_guidance — every control varied=False) while FULL's realized controls are non-degenerate (max_tokens and response_delay_s varied=True) and FULL's realized delay max >= 3.0x the flat delay (B4 ab_margins.response_delay_s: low >= 3.0x high)

POSITIVE CONTROL (gate, canal no dormido): el canal de timing produce artefactos realizados divergentes de FULL (n_proactive o eventos disparados por >= 5%, u horas proactivas no idénticas) — medido en el horizonte confirmatorio

memory_store channel ablated (behavioral, G2): the lane RETURNED non-zero raw-dialogue evidence (context_turns > 0 across lane-routed chain probes) and its retrieval differs from FULL's (raw window with no episode ids vs FULL's non-empty retrieved-episode set)

memory_store channel ablated (behavioral, G2): the lane RETURNED non-zero retrieved evidence (n_retrieved > 0 across lane-routed chain probes) AND its retrieved-episode set DIFFERS from FULL's (set-level comparison of what the lane actually retrieved — not lane identity)

gate.evidence: 941/941 suite green at G2 close (commit 454a799 + test fix)

three_flags_two_causes.NO_LIFE: broken ablation, fixed by goldfish c24d880 (a fix, not a horizon change)
three_flags_two_causes.STRUCTURED_NO_STATE: horizon artifact — score feedback cannot land before day 2-3; min_days=4
three_flags_two_causes.SIMPLE_RAG: horizon artifact — store below retrieval surface (limit=8) until ~day 5-10; min_days=10

reconciliation.decision: COUNT_DIVERGENCE_MIN stays 0.15. The manifest claim is tested on the real matrix; if not met at margin, report not-met with the gap leg noted, or B5 strengthens coupling weights before G4-freeze review (user-approved options).

hard_invariants.ablations_ablate: every matrix condition demonstrably ablates its target channel, asserted before generation (G2 gate)

hypotheses: H1: endogenous stochastic state (mood/timing/initiative) is perceptible to an independent observer in the transcript
H2: structured memory carries verifiable trajectory recall through its own lane
H3: the timing channel (score feedback) measurably changes proactive behavior at 30 days
H4: ablating life-state persistence (goldfish) changes arc identity continuity without breaking grounding
H5: actuator controls visibly flatten generation controls when pinned
H6: the positive control (NO_TIMING_FEEDBACK) is detectable — if the pipeline cannot see it, the pipeline is broken

dimensions.name: Persona enactment / identity consistency
dimensions.anchor_1: each turn feels like a different persona; no stable identity
dimensions.anchor_9: one coherent persona with a consistent voice and history throughout

dimensions.name: Trajectory recall / temporal continuity
dimensions.anchor_1: never recalls past events; timeline is flat or contradictory
dimensions.anchor_9: consistently recalls the trajectory of shared events in correct temporal order

dimensions.name: Relational quality
dimensions.anchor_1: cold, generic, or intrusive; no sense of relationship
dimensions.anchor_9: warm, respectful, attuned; the relationship deepens naturally

dimensions.name: Behavioral dynamics / stochastic-state observability
dimensions.anchor_1: robotic, identical responses; no rhythm or initiative
dimensions.anchor_9: human-like variation in timing, initiative and engagement that tracks the situation

protocol_v2.aggregation: Bradley-Terry per dimension, per family; disagreement reported
protocol_v2.attention_probes: control pairs (corrupt_transcript) resolved under both families
protocol_v2.degraded_transcript: a deliberately degraded transcript must be resolved by both families (DoD item 6)

judge.subset_rule: final/important subset = companion matrix conditions x seeds 5001-5003, judged blind by >=2 independent judge families; per-dimension disagreement reported.

ungrounded_proactive.meaning: proactive message without a valid grounded intent (invariant 5)

wrong_intent.meaning: proactive message whose intent fails source/hook re-derivation (invariant 6/7)

stranded_opportunities.meaning: pending schedule events / intents overdue at run end

cycle_state_leakage.meaning: raw cycle/hormonal variables in conversation-visible text (invariant 16)

memory_provenance_failures.meaning: episodes whose source turns do not exist

duplicate_turns.meaning: duplicated turns across restart (resume must not rewind)

life_dead_duration.meaning: consecutive days at run end with no active arc and no completed arc

M8a_rho_init_tokens.meaning: actuation must produce measurable state->observable coupling
